tagline: Global market leader of innovative thermal management and pneumatic comfort technologies for automotive and medical applications.
hero_kpi_rationale: Gentherm demonstrates explosive growth of 70.8% in its climate electronics and comfort product range, reflecting major innovation in thermal management technologies. This substantial growth outpaces that of its other segments and positions the company as a leader in the adoption of advanced electronic solutions for automotive comfort.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cybersecurity risks and implements measures to mitigate them, including a Vice President Chief Information Officer reporting to the Board of Directors. The Audit Committee regularly receives reports on cybersecurity incidents and information security initiatives.

risks.title: Geopolitical
